That exception is record 49's outcome {status exception, exceptionClass java.lang.RuntimeException, assertion false, message 'INTERNAL COMPILER ERROR. ... Cannot transpile yet: destructuring assignment referencing await or yield in lhs, in nested sub-expression: OBJECT_PATTERN ...'}, which ReplayMain compares exactly (status, class, message), so the asserted state is replay-compared. Gate (a) checks a via for every record of the method, and the method's first record (48, the yield-in-RHS rewrite, outcome normal) has no exception outcome and no post-call assertion of its own, so the gate reports this claim invalid for record 48 ('outcome claim needs a non-assertion exception with a message') until a via can be restricted to the record whose outcome the assertion inspects (not adopted: it changes a gate definition, D-017 freeze). Record 49 alone satisfies the outcome rule. No other via names the asserted state: record 48's postCall keys (compiler externProperties, accessorSummary, allowableFeatures, injectedLibraries, typeMismatchesError) say nothing about the exception, and a rust_unit_test 'exception' entry would contradict the replay-compared outcome.
